license.basis: SuttaCentral publishes most scripture translations under the author's own copyright or licence, not CC0. The licence is attached to the work on SuttaCentral; `translation/en/sujato/` carries no machine-readable licence field at this commit, so the terms are recorded here as NOASSERTION rather than guessed.

referenceEditions.note: Reference layer for translation triangulation. Never outranks the pinned Pāli root; see skill/translation.md 3.2. The only English edition at this commit that covers all five Pāli Nikāyas.

license.basis: Third-party scripture translation, so SuttaCentral's group 2 applies: the copyright stays with the translator and the work is used under its own licence or the author's permission. `translation/vi/phantuananh/` carries no machine-readable licence field at this commit.
license.sourceRequest: SuttaCentral asks that any reuse state its origin: 'Ghi rõ nguồn gốc xuất xứ' (licensing:10). The reader and the credits page do this.

referenceEditions.note: The existing Vietnamese translation, for terminology and phrasing cross-checks. At this commit it covers the Dhammapada only (26 files under kn/dhp); the rest of Thích Minh Châu's canon is not distributed through bilara-data, so absence elsewhere is a property of the upstream snapshot, not a gap in this repository.

license.basis: SuttaCentral's own work, which it places in the public domain under CC0 1.0 (licensing:6).

referenceEditions.note: SuttaCentral's own Vietnamese statements of licensing, acknowledgements and citation. Not scripture — these are the terms and credits the reference layers are displayed under, which is why they are pinned and hash-verified rather than left as a claim in our own prose.
